method.cycle: E = US presidential election year 1952-2024; Y1..Y4 = E+1..E+4
method.vote_day: first Tuesday after the first Monday of November; 'after' = first close strictly after
method.recalled_timing: first close of Y1 -> first close after the Y2 midterm
method.midterm_windows: first close after the Y2 midterm -> last close of Y3 / first close after the Y4 election
method.out_from_march_y3: first close on or after 19 March Y3 -> first close of Y4 / after the Y4 election / of the next Y1; positive = what being out cost
method.placebo: same holding length (22 and 14 months) from the first close of each of the 48 cycle months
method.bound: mean resolves only beyond 2.8 x SD / sqrt(n)
method.cash: 0%; dividends excluded for the S&P 500 and TAIEX price indices
